svg.title: A finite fixed-correspondence cost illustrates weighting
svg.desc: Two zero-mean radial displacement fields on a fixed 64-point ring have equal root-mean-square amplitude, 1 millimetre. Solid smooth and dashed oscillatory fields receive different scores when nonnegative neighbor-difference weight increases. This grid-dependent quadratic score is not a path energy, elastic geodesic, physical strain, varifold distance or clinical result.
